# Fallout on Prime: Filming for the second season of the series has been completed

![Fallout on Prime: Filming for the 2nd season of the series has been completed](/uploads/509_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

*Image: @falloutonprime on X*

Now the time has finally come! After the great success of the first Fallout series on Amazon Prime *, we were eagerly waiting for the second season. Fallout on Prime announced on X that filming has been completed. That means we can hopefully see the start of season 2 very soon. As soon as a date is set, you will find out here.

![Fallout Prime: Filming for Season 2 Completed](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fallout-prime-production-wrapped2025-05-09-06-27-18.jpg) 

Source: @falloutonprime on X

## Where does Fallout Season 2 take place?

The final scene of season 1 has already revealed to us that the next season will take place in **New Vegas**, which we already know from the video game “Fallout: New Vegas”. Based on this, we can already imagine certain factions and places that we will see in the second season. There are even concrete references to **Cesar's Legion** and the **NCR** (New Californian Republic), as well as encounters with **Deathclaws**.

Leaks from the filming via Reddit:

## What awaits us in Fallout Season 2?

We can expect great things here. **Walton Goggins** (Ghoul actor) said in an interview with Deadline 

I can tell you, I thought the first season was exceptional. Personally, I was very happy with it. But this beats them by far.

What the writers have put together to tell this story is really something... I can't wait for people to see it.

![Walt Goggins on Fallout Season 2](/uploads/nukaknights-post-fallout-prime-production-wrapped-walt-goggins.jpg) 

Source: @deadline on X

## Cast in Fallout Season 2

Of course, we will see many familiar faces from the first season again in season 2. But there are also a few new additions. For example, it was announced that **Macaulay Culkin** ("Home Alone") has a role. And Jonathan Nolan even talked about **Aaron Paul** (“Breaking Bad”), although it is still unclear whether he will appear in the second season.

**Expected cast (via Gamesradar):**

- **Ella Purnell** : Lucy MacLean
- **Walton Goggins** : The Ghoul / Cooper Howard
- **Aaron Moten**: Maximus
- **Kyle MacLachlan** : Hank MacLean
- **Moisés Arias** : Norm MacLean
- **Sarita Choudhury**: Moldavian
- **Frances Turner** : Barb
- **Leslie Uggams** : Betty
- **Macaulay Culkin** : Unknown

That all really sounds very promising.

We are very excited to see when the second season will be available on Amazon Prime *.
